useCases.title: Offshore platform system monitoring
useCases.value: Monitors historian and controller tag changes that could impact process safety on offshore installations.

useCases.title: Safety-critical system integrity
useCases.value: Flags overdue security patches and unsigned firmware changes on safety-related hosts.

useCases.title: PSA compliance evidence
useCases.value: Packages access reviews, alarm management changes, and temporary bypasses for PSA inspection readiness.

useCases.title: HSE system audit trails
useCases.value: Tracks privileged edits to occupational health and safety systems tied to offshore operations.

useCases.title: Petroleum facility access control
useCases.value: Correlates physical badge events with logical sessions into engineering workstations for facility access control.

useCases.title: Petroleumsforskriften §11 — emergency preparedness drill evidence
useCases.value: §11 requires demonstrable preparedness for emergency situations; drill cadence and activation records are auditor-facing evidence.

useCases.title: Petroleumsforskriften §3 — operator safety/security obligation register
useCases.value: §3 establishes the operator's general duty of care; continuous monitoring of recurring obligations is good stewardship evidence.
